info.name: Keystone HRMS API
info.description:
# 📋 Keystone HRMS — Complete API Collection

Complete collection of **all API routes** in the Keystone Human Resource Management System (Next.js App Router).

---

## 🔀 Collection Structure

The collection is divided into **two sides**:

| Section | Purpose |
|---|---|
| 🏥 **Health Check** | Server & database connectivity tests |
| 🔐 **Authentication** | Signup, email verification, login (NextAuth), session |
| 🛠️ **Server Side — Admin APIs** | Admin-only endpoints (dashboard, employees, managers, holidays) |
| 👤 **Frontend Side — Employee APIs** | Endpoints consumed by employee dashboard (profile, attendance, leaves, notifications) |
| 🎯 **Performance & Training** | Reviews, training catalog & enrollments |
| 📢 **Recruitment** | Job postings & applications (admin) |
| 📊 **Analytics & Reports** | Dashboards, trends and report generation |
| 📤 **Uploads** | File upload (logo / profile) |

---

## 🚀 How to Use

1. Import this file into **Postman** (Import → File → `postman.json`).
2. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default `http://localhost:3000`).
3. Set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` and `employeeEmail` / `employeePassword` variables with real accounts.
4. Run **Auth → Get CSRF Token** then **Auth → Login (Admin)** — Postman saves the `next-auth.session-token` cookie automatically and every following request is authenticated.

> ⚠️ **Note:** Login uses NextAuth's credentials flow. You must call **Get CSRF Token** first (it stores `csrfToken` + cookies), then **Login**. After that, all protected routes work.

request.description: Tests the Prisma → PostgreSQL connection. Returns total users, companies, profiles count and sample data. **Auth: Public**

Creates a new **Company + HR (ADMIN) user** in one transaction.

**Validation (Zod):**
- `companyName` min 2 chars (must be unique)
- `name` min 2 chars
- `email` valid & unique
- `phone` exactly 10 digits
- `password` min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 number, 1 special char
- `confirmPassword` must match

**Success `201`:** returns user + company. In development also returns `verificationUrl` (token auto-saved to collection variable).
**Auth: Public**

Verifies a user's email using the token.

- `400` — token missing / invalid / expired
- `200` — verified (or already verified)

**Auth: Public**
NextAuth CSRF endpoint. Saves `csrfToken` to collection variables and sets the `next-auth.csrf-token` cookie. **Run this before Login.**

exec: console.log('✅ Admin logged in — session cookie saved automatically');

urlencoded.description: Email OR Employee ID (e.g. ACM0001) — both work

request.description:
NextAuth **credentials login**. Accepts email **or** employeeId as `email` field.

Sets `next-auth.session-token` cookie (JWT, 30 days) — Postman stores it automatically for the domain.

**Errors:** `Invalid login credentials`, `Please verify your email before logging in`.
Same credentials flow, but for an EMPLOYEE account. Re-run **Get CSRF Token** before this if switching accounts.
Returns the current session: `id, name, email, role (ADMIN/EMPLOYEE), employeeId, companyId, companyName, companyLogo`. Returns `{}` when not logged in.
Destroys the current session.

request.description:
Updates profile + job details (upsert). All fields optional.

- Employees can update **everything except** `name`, `jobPosition`, `department`, `manager`, `workLocation`
- ADMIN can also update those (admin-only fields)
- `phone` must be 10 digits, `personalEmail` must be valid email (Zod)

**Auth: self or ADMIN**

Marks today's check-in (status becomes `PRESENT`).

`400` — `Already checked in today` if repeated.
**Auth: any logged-in user**

Marks today's check-out.

`400` — `Please check in first` / `Already checked out today`.
**Auth: any logged-in user**

Lightweight status used by the dashboard check-in widget: `{ checkedIn, checkedOut, attendance }`.
**Auth: any logged-in user**

query.description: Filter by user (employees can only pass their own id)
ADMIN only — search by employee name or employeeId

request.description:
Attendance list with computed `workHours` and `extraHours` (hours beyond 8 = overtime).

- Employees: only their own records
- ADMIN: all company records (optional `userId`, `date`, `search` filters)

**Auth: any logged-in user**

Leave requests, newest first, includes employee `name` + `employeeId`.

- Employees: own requests only
- ADMIN: all company requests (optionally filtered by `userId`)

**Auth: any logged-in user**

Creates a leave request (`status: PENDING`).

**Required:** `type` (PAID / SICK / UNPAID), `startDate`, `endDate`
**Optional:** `reason`, `attachmentUrl`

`days` is auto-calculated. All company ADMINs get a `LEAVE_REQUEST` notification.
**Auth: any logged-in user**

Approve or reject a leave request.

**Body:** `id` (required), `status` (`APPROVED` / `REJECTED`), `adminComment` (optional)

The employee receives a `LEAVE_UPDATE` notification.
**Auth: ADMIN only**

Paginated notifications for the logged-in user + `unreadCount`.
**Auth: any logged-in user**

Creates a notification for a user (goes through NotificationService — email/push/SMS flags set).

**Required:** `userId, type, title, message`
**Optional:** `priority` (LOW/NORMAL/HIGH/URGENT), `category` (SYSTEM/EMAIL/PUSH/SMS), `actionUrl`, `actionText`

**Auth: ADMIN only**

**Auth: any logged-in user**

Marks **all** of the current user's notifications as read.
**Auth: any logged-in user**

request.description:
Creates a review. `overallRating` auto-averages the 5 ratings if not provided.

- ADMIN creating for others → `status: DRAFT`
- Employee creating for self → `status: SUBMITTED`
- Employee cannot create for someone else (`401`)

**Auth: any logged-in user**
